invariants.contract: A batch of a book, a second book and a podcast answers {success:true, updates:3}, stores each payload, moves each updatedAt, rewrites each metadata.json and emits one item_updated per item. Repeating the batch answers updates:0 and changes nothing; a batch with one unchanged and one changed item answers updates:1 and emits item_updated for the changed item only. A batch that creates an author and a series and a second batch that removes them applies both, deletes the emptied author and series after the loop and emits author_added, series_removed and author_removed. A podcast entry with an invalid auto download cron is skipped without failing the batch: the other entries are applied and the count excludes it.
